start: init; title jump for 1 tick; neutral ticks until PLAYER exists in room 0; frame 0 after that draw
finish: first actual engine transition from room 0 (100m) to room 1 (200m)
objective: minimize update+draw ticks to finish; unsuccessful runs are unranked
allowed: edit button timeline only; all six input bits, including simultaneous opposite directions
randomness: seed and initialization fixed by runner; no candidate seed, resets or state writes
replay: fresh process from canonical start; every update followed by exactly one draw
scope: ccleste benchmark category, not a claim of official PICO-8 TAS equivalence
